name: hud_ui_panel_set_font_handle
description: HudUiPanel::SetFontHandle stores the panel font handle.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x40beb0 loads the font handle argument and stores it to self->hFont at offset 0x154.
Native smoke zhud_panel_text_color_shadow_smoke sets the font handle through HudUiPanel::SetFontHandle and verifies HudUiPanel::GetFont returns the same handle.
